title: Govern package feeds and upstream dependencies
prompt: Several teams consume packages from public registries and publish internal packages. The organization wants a controlled Azure Artifacts feed that supports review before consumers receive a release. How should feed scope, upstream sources, permissions and views be considered?

checks.value: make every consumer a feed owner

rubric: The response chooses feed scope based on which projects or teams need access.
It treats upstream sources as controlled dependency inputs and checks who can add or change them.
It distinguishes publishing from consuming permissions and uses views to expose selected package versions.
It verifies current feed and view permission semantics before changing access.
No feed, upstream source or permission is changed.
acceptance: The response gives a least-privilege feed design that controls upstream inputs and promotes validated package versions to consumers.
